notes: hoodrich.com is NOT the brand: it belongs to Hood-Rich Architecture, Springfield MO. The official store is hoodrichuk.com ('Hoodrich Official Store | From Nothing To Something'; Hoodrich Ltd trademark). Any stored hoodrich.com URL is a wrong record.
